faces.transcription:
STOP
Draw this card just before you set up your first game in January.

"All right team, say hello to the new you. This is the alias you'll be using for the time bein'."

Take the 4 passports. Choose a set of 3 photos and place 1 on each alias of the passport. Then, on the first page (the one with the ✦ star) give each alias a name. Add a Cover Occupation sticker to each alias. Leave the Specialization empty for now. Modify its appearance using Disguise stickers.

When you have finished making your aliases, continue reading.
